subagents.title: Subagents
subagents.description: Which assistant, work profile and model the subagents Flint starts run with. Without a choice here a subagent inherits its parent's assistant and work profile (long personas are shortened). This never changes what a subagent may do: its tools and approvals stay what the run allows.
subagents.headlessNote: Assistants and work profiles apply in the desktop app only. Runs from the command line follow the model choices.
subagents.defaultsDesc: Each one inherits from the run that started it unless you pick something here.
subagents.inheritDesc: Use whatever the run that started the subagent uses.
subagents.assistantDesc: The persona a subagent works under.
subagents.profileDesc: How a subagent approaches the work.
subagents.modelDesc: Run subagents on another model, for example a faster one for read-only surveys.
subagents.letModelChooseDesc: On: a role or model the calling model asks for is used. Off: these settings always win.
subagents.precedence: Order: what the model asks for (if allowed), then the role's setting, then the setting for all subagents, then the parent.

checkForUpdatesDesc: Check if a newer version of Flint is available.
failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Failed to relocate data folder. Please try again.
factoryResetDesc: This will reset all app settings to their defaults. This can't be undone. We only recommend this if the app is corrupted.
documentationDesc: Learn how to use Flint and explore its features.
releaseNotesDesc: See what's new in the latest version of Flint.
discordDesc: Join our community for support and discussions.
reportAnIssueDesc: Found a bug? Help us out by filing an issue on GitHub.
creditsDesc1: 👋 Flint is built with ❤️ by Jozkah, based on Jan from the Menlo Research team.
creditsDesc2: Special thanks to our open-source dependencies—especially llama.cpp and Tauri—and to our amazing AI community.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Location for messages, downloaded models and other data.
dataFolder.unavailable: Your data folder {{path}} is not available right now: its drive may be disconnected, or the folder was moved. Flint is using the default folder shown above until it is back. Your setting has not been changed.
dataFolder.appLogsDesc: View detailed logs of the App.

others.spellCheckDesc: Enable spell check for your threads.
others.resetFactoryDesc: Restore application to its initial state, erasing all models and chat history. This action is irreversible and recommended only if the application is corrupted.

shortcuts.pressKeys: Press the new shortcut… (Esc to cancel)
shortcuts.conflict: Already used by {{command}}. Choose another shortcut, or change that one first.
shortcuts.commandPaletteDesc: Open the command palette: navigation, actions, conversations and settings.
shortcuts.switchAssistantDesc: Cycle to the next assistant in the chat.
shortcuts.splitViewDesc: Open another conversation beside the one on screen.
shortcuts.maxPanesDesc: How many conversations split view shows at once, the main one included.
shortcuts.nextPaneDesc: Move to the next pane in split view.
shortcuts.previousPaneDesc: Move to the previous pane in split view.

interface.title: Interface
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Where toast notifications appear. On Windows, the default is bottom-right so popups do not cover the window controls.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Display tokens/sec and token count inline below assistant messages. When off, a compact icon shows the details on click.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Use the accent color as the background of your messages. When off, they match assistant messages with plain text on a neutral background.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Add a Preview tab to HTML and SVG code blocks. HTML runs the model-generated page in a sandboxed frame that executes its own scripts but cannot access Flint, your files, or the network; SVG renders statically with scripts disabled. Off by default.
interface.composerRailButtons: Output buttons in the Cowork composer
interface.composerRailButtonsDesc: Show Preview, Code, Changes, Activity and Timeline under the Cowork message box. Off, one Output button in the header opens the panel.
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Automatically summarize new conversations into a thread title. Turn off to keep the default title until you rename it yourself.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Set the app window's background color.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Set the main content area's background color.
interface.primaryDesc: Set the primary color for interface accents.
interface.accentDesc: Select the accent color used across the UI.
interface.destructiveDesc: Set the highlight color for destructive actions.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Reset all interface settings to default.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: All interface settings have been restored to default.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Choose how the chat viewport should react when new messages arrive.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Keeps the viewport anchored to the latest message you send.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Automatically follows along as replies stream in real time.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Show token counter inside chat input. When disabled, token counter appears below the input.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Display line numbers in code blocks.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Reset code block style to default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Code block style has been restored to default.
interface.transcriptViewDesc: How much of each turn Chat, Cowork and Rooms show. Approvals, questions and errors always show.
interface.transcriptViewNormalDesc: The answer and anything that needs you. Tool calls fold into one steps row.
interface.transcriptViewThinkingDesc: Adds the model's reasoning. Tool calls stay folded.
interface.transcriptViewVerboseDesc: Everything: full reasoning and every tool call open with its parameters and output.

hardware.name: Name
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Use Vulkan API for GPU acceleration. Do not enable Vulkan if you have an NVIDIA GPU as it may cause compatibility issues.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: No GPUs are visible to the llama.cpp engine. Models will run on the CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: How llama.cpp talks to this GPU
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Use this API for this GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: The GPU shares one memory pool with the CPU — models draw from the same memory as the rest of the system.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: The URL and port of your proxy server.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Credentials for the proxy server, if required.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: A comma-separated list of hosts to bypass the proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Allow self-signed or unverified certificates. This may be required for some proxies but reduces security. Only enable if you trust your proxy.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Validate the SSL certificate when connecting to the proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificate of the proxy's host.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificates of peer connections.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Validate the SSL certificates of destination hosts.
httpsProxy.caBundleDesc: A PEM file of certificate authorities to trust in addition to the system's, for a company proxy or a private model gateway. Certificates are still checked -- host names, dates and the chain -- and nothing is trusted if the file cannot be used. Applies to new connections.
httpsProxy.caBundleNone: Only the platform's certificate authorities are trusted.
httpsProxy.caBundleInUse: Trusting {{count}} certificate(s) from this bundle as well as the platform's.
httpsProxy.caBundleBroken: This bundle cannot be used ({{kind}}): outbound HTTPS trusts nothing until it is fixed or removed.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Let models search and read the web using Flint's built-in tools.
webSearch.enableDesc: Advertise the web_search and web_fetch tools to models that support tool use. Works out of the box with no API key.
webSearch.providerDesc: Choose the backend that answers web_search and web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Optional. Provide a {{provider}} API key for higher rate limits and structured results. Leave empty to use the free keyless endpoint.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Required. {{provider}} needs an API key to return results.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Required. The base URL of your {{provider}} instance, with the JSON API enabled.
webSearch.noSetupDesc: Searches {{provider}} directly, with no API key or account. After many searches in a short time {{provider}} can ask for a bot check; wait a minute, or pick Exa or You.com, which also need no key.
webSearch.endpointSearchDesc: The base URL of your self-hosted search instance.

visualize.title: Visual widgets
visualize.enabledDesc: Diagrams, mockups, charts and small interactive explainers shown inline in the conversation. Adds two short tool descriptions to each request.
visualize.cdn: Let widgets load libraries from cdnjs and jsdelivr
visualize.cdnDesc: Off by default. When on, a widget may load scripts (such as a charting library) from cdnjs.cloudflare.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net, and nowhere else. It still cannot send data out.
visualize.maxHeightDesc: A widget grows to this height in pixels, then scrolls. You can always open it full size.

agentTools.shellDescription: Where the agent's commands run, what they can reach, and how its commits are credited.
agentTools.skillsHelp: Skills are instructions the agent can load when a task needs them. Skills that come from a plugin are read-only here.
agentTools.computerAppsDesc: Leave empty to let the assistant control any app. Add apps to restrict it to only their windows (Windows only).
agentTools.computerAppsLimited: The assistant can only control windows of the apps below. Click one to remove it.
agentTools.computerExclusionsDesc: Mark parts of the screen the assistant must never click, type or scroll in, such as a button that would overwrite your save file.
agentTools.computerExclusionsCount_one: {{count}} area is off-limits to the assistant.
agentTools.computerExclusionsCount_other: {{count}} areas are off-limits to the assistant.
agentTools.computerExclusionsPick: This is your screen right now. Drag to draw each area the assistant must never act in. Position the app you care about first, then reopen this.
agentTools.attributionCommits: Add Flint as co-author on commits
agentTools.attributionCommitsDesc: Commits the agent makes end with a Co-Authored-By trailer naming Flint and the model that wrote them.
agentTools.attributionPullRequests: Add 'Generated with Flint' to pull requests
agentTools.attributionPullRequestsDesc: Pull request descriptions the agent writes end with a 'Generated with Flint' line.

toolchains.title: Sandbox toolchains
toolchains.description: These are installed but the sandbox cannot run them: their folder does not allow sandboxed apps to read and run what is inside. You can allow it for one toolchain at a time.
toolchains.allRunnable: Every installed toolchain the sandbox looks for can run in it.
toolchains.unrunnable: Installed in {{folder}}, but the sandbox cannot run it.
toolchains.notGrantable: Installed, but the sandbox cannot run it, and allowing its folder would not help (Git for Windows and other MSYS2 tools never run in the sandbox).
toolchains.launcher: The py launcher runs a Python installed elsewhere. It works once a Python runs in the sandbox: allow python instead.
toolchains.grantedAt: The sandbox may run what is in {{folder}}.
toolchains.confirmBody: This changes the permissions of the folder below, where {{program}} is installed, and only that folder and what is inside it: it adds an entry that lets every sandboxed Windows app (ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES) read and run the files inside it. Nothing else in your user profile is opened. You can revoke it here at any time, which removes exactly that entry.
toolchains.needsAdmin: Installed in {{folder}}, which only an administrator can change. Needs administrator: run this in an elevated terminal:

agentTools.title: Agent Tools
agentTools.description: Give models a private scratch workspace for each conversation, plus memories and skills kept permanently in your Flint data folder.
agentTools.enableDesc: Advertise the built-in workspace, memory and skill tools to models that support tool use. Tools that need approval stay unavailable.
agentTools.chatDelegationDesc: A chat can hand a job to a subagent, or start several at once. Each subagent works with the same tools and asks before it changes anything, as the chat does. Needs the agent tools above.
agentTools.shellSandboxed: Commands run confined by {{backend}}: they can only write inside the conversation workspace, and files in your home folder are not readable.
agentTools.shellUnavailable: No sandbox is available on this system, so the bash tool is not offered. Commands are never run unconfined.
agentTools.networkDesc: Let commands reach the network. Needed for things like installing packages or fetching a repository. On by default; turn it off so a command cannot send anything off your machine.
agentTools.noMemories: No memories yet. Models add them with the memory_write tool as they learn things worth keeping.
agentTools.noSkills: No skills yet. A skill is a reusable set of instructions a model can load on demand.
agentTools.editMemoryDesc: One topic per note. Models read these back with the memory_read tool.
agentTools.editSkillDesc: Markdown instructions, optionally with a description in YAML frontmatter. The description is what models see before loading the skill.
agentTools.loadFailed: Could not load the agent workspace

localApiServer.title: Local API Server
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: View detailed logs of the local API server.
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Automatically start the Local API Server when the application launches.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Keep the server running in the system tray when the window is closed. When off, closing the window quits Flint and stops the server.
localApiServer.serverHostLanWarning: 0.0.0.0 makes the server reachable from other devices on your network. Set an API key, and use the machine's LAN address (not localhost) from the other device.
localApiServer.serverHostLanNoTrusted: Trusted Hosts is empty: add the address other devices will use to reach this machine, or their requests may be rejected.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Port number for the API server.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Authenticate requests with an API key.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Hosts allowed to access the server, separated by commas.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Allow cross-origin requests to the API server.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Enable detailed server logs for debugging.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Time to wait for a response from the local model, seconds.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Local model to load automatically when the server starts.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: To help us improve Flint, you can share anonymous data like feature usage and user counts. We never collect your chats or personal information.
privacy.privacyPolicy: You have full control over your data. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
privacy.analyticsDesc: To improve Flint, we need to understand how it's used—but only with your help. You can change this setting anytime.
privacy.privacyPromises: Your choice here won't change our core privacy promises:
privacy.promise1: Your conversations stay private and on your device
privacy.promise2: We never collect your personal information or chat content
privacy.promise3: All data sharing is anonymous and aggregated
privacy.promise4: You can opt out anytime without losing functionality
privacy.promise5: We're transparent about what we collect and why

general.replyLanguageDesc: Make the model always answer in this language in chats, Cowork and rooms. Automatic follows what you write.
general.fallbackModelsDesc: If the chosen model is overloaded, unreachable or not loaded, retry the message on these models in order.
general.couldNotRelocateToRoot: Cannot relocate data folder to root directory. Please choose another location.
general.couldNotResetRootDirectory: Cannot reset data folder when it's set to a root directory. Please delete the data folder manually.
general.failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Failed to relocate data folder. Please try again.
general.buildUpdateDesc: Flint 0.9.0 is a nightly build: it is rebuilt from the latest code and the version number stays the same. When on, Flint asks GitHub once on start (at most twice a day) whether a newer build exists. Off by default; nothing is sent either way except that request.
general.buildNewer: A newer build is available. Download it again from the release page to update.
general.buildUnknown: Could not tell: this build has no commit recorded, or the release could not be reached.
general.checkForUpdatesDesc: Check if a newer version of Flint is available.
general.autoUpdateCheckDesc: Automatically check for updates on startup and periodically.
general.factoryResetDesc: This will reset all app settings to their defaults. This can't be undone. We only recommend this if the app is corrupted.
general.keepAppDataDesc: Your chat history and conversations will be preserved.
general.keepModelsAndConfigsDesc: Downloaded models, engine settings, and MCP configurations will be preserved.
general.clearWebDataDesc: Removes cached local storage and UI preferences kept by the app window. The interface resets to its default state.
general.huggingfaceTokenDesc: Your HuggingFace API token for accessing models.
general.closeToTrayDesc: Closing the window hides Flint to the system tray instead of quitting. Quit from the tray menu.
general.downloadLimitDesc: Cap model downloads at this many MB per second. 0 means unlimited.
general.exportLogsDesc: Save the app log with known API keys and tokens removed, to attach to a bug report. Review it before sharing.
general.importChatGptDesc: Bring in your chats from a ChatGPT data export. Pick the conversations.json file from the export zip.
general.importChatGptNone: No conversations found in that file
general.documentationDesc: Learn how to use Flint and explore its features.
general.releaseNotesDesc: See what's new in the latest version of Flint.
general.discordDesc: Join our community for support and discussions.
general.reportAnIssueDesc: Found a bug? Help us out by filing an issue on GitHub.
general.creditsDesc1: 👋 Flint is built with ❤️ by Jozkah, based on Jan from the Menlo Research team.
general.creditsDesc2: Special thanks to our open-source dependencies—especially llama.cpp and Tauri—and to our amazing AI community.

attachments.subtitle: Configure document attachments, size limits, and retrieval behavior.
attachments.enableDesc: Allow uploading and indexing documents for retrieval.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Choose how parsed documents are added to conversations.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Fraction of the model context used as the cutoff for inlining parsed files on local models.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Maximum size per file. Enforced at upload and processing time.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Minimum similarity score (0-1). Only used for linear cosine search, not ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Choose between sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, or auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Approximate max characters per chunk for embeddings.

changeDataFolder.title: Change Data Folder Location
changeDataFolder.description: Are you sure you want to change the data folder location? This will copy all your data to the new location and restart the application. Your existing data folder is left in place and is not deleted.

memory.automaticallySaveDesc: When this is off, anything Flint infers is offered for your approval before it is kept. Explicit saves always work. Memories never leave this machine.
memory.storedDesc: How many memories are kept in each scope, and how much space they use.
memory.rememberedDesc: Search, edit, pin and forget what Flint remembers for this chat, this project, or across chats.

compaction.title: Context compaction
compaction.autoDescription: Make room before a conversation outgrows the model's context window. Shared by Chat, Cowork and the CLI.
compaction.reserveDescription: Headroom kept free: compaction starts once a conversation uses more than the window minus this.
compaction.keepRecentDescription: The most recent messages an agent run always keeps word for word.
compaction.strategyDescription: Summarize older messages with the model, or drop them with a note.
compaction.saveFailed: The compaction policy could not be saved

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: Used for primary actions, selection, tabs and focus. Success, warning and error colours never change.
accent.defaultValues: Neutral slate, matches the rest of the interface
accent.independentOfTheme: Markers and links are adjusted for contrast in each theme; your colour stays the button fill. The accent is independent of Light, Dark and System theme.
accent.hexHelp: Six hex digits, such as #3B6EA5. A valid value applies as you type.
accent.hexInvalidCharacters: “{{value}}” contains characters that are not hex digits. The current accent is unchanged.
accent.hexInvalid: “{{value}}” is not a valid hex colour. Use six digits such as #3B6EA5. The current accent is unchanged.
accent.nearSuccess: This accent is close to the success colour. Selected items also use a side marker and labels, and success always shows a check icon.
accent.nearDanger: This accent is close to the error colour. Destructive buttons stay outlined and say what they remove.
accent.previewLabel: Preview of the accent in this theme

appearance.completionSoundDesc: Play a short sound when a chat reply or a Cowork run finishes on its own. Not played for a reply you stopped or one that failed.
appearance.reduceMotionDesc: Turn off animations in Flint. Flint does not follow the system setting, so motion stays on unless you switch this.

pageDesc.general: Language, the data folder, logs and app-wide options.
pageDesc.appearance: How Flint looks on this computer.
pageDesc.memory: What Flint remembers between conversations, and where it is kept.
pageDesc.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts. Choose a shortcut to change it; a combination already in use is refused.
pageDesc.assistants: Assistants set the instructions a conversation starts with.
pageDesc.attachments: How files attached to a message are read and searched.
pageDesc.mcpServers: External tools Flint connects to through the Model Context Protocol.
pageDesc.webSearch: Let Flint search the web when a conversation needs it.
pageDesc.claudeCode: Run Claude Code with models Flint provides.
pageDesc.extensions: Extensions installed in this copy of Flint.
pageDesc.agentTools: Files, shell and network access for Flint's built-in agent tools.
pageDesc.localApiServer: An OpenAI-compatible server other apps can use to reach your models.
pageDesc.httpsProxy: Send Flint's internet requests through a proxy.

imageDescription.title: Images and text-only models
imageDescription.enabled: Describe images for models that cannot see
imageDescription.enabledDesc: A model without vision gets a written description of each attached image, made by a model that can see, in the image's place. Off, it gets nothing for the image.
imageDescription.modelDesc: The model that writes the descriptions. A local model is used only if you pick it here.
imageDescription.modelAuto: Automatic (first remote model that can see)
imageDescription.noVisionModel: No model that can see is available. Add one, or mark a model as vision-capable, to use this.
imageDescription.embedDesc: Also store each image's description with the chat's documents so it can be searched later. This sends every attached image to the description model.
